name: Spa-Francorchamps Grand Prix circuit
notes: Stations are metres along the baked lap centerline, measured from the Bus Stop chicane exit in race direction (public/data/spa-lap.json).
Turn numbers and names: FIA/Formula 1 corner numbering for the Belgian Grand Prix (19 turns). Turn stations: the turn-in and exit of each corner found on the baked centerline by curvature.

Timing lines: FIA 2024 Belgian GP circuit map. Sector 1 line 145 m before Turn 5, Sector 2 line 48 m before Turn 15 (both measured from our turn-in point). Control (timing/finish) line and the separate start line: EM ruling from the georeferenced SPW 2026 orthophoto (control paint ~225 m, grid-leading start line ~347 m; about +-5 m), consistent with the ~124 m start/finish offset implied by the FIA race distance over 44 laps. Pole is on the right (FIA 2024 pit-lane drawing).
Road width 12 m and track limit 7.2 m from the centerline (car centre) are assumptions.
